LESSON: PARABLE OF THE MUSTARD SEED

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.8.2: Parable of the mustard seed

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Parable of the mustard seed. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How does the parable of the mustard seed relate to the kingdom of God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text,
2. describe how the kingdom of God grows from a small beginning,
3. explain how they contribute to the growth of the kingdom of God,
4. appreciate the growth of God’s kingdom by evangelising to others. The learner is guided to: parable, the school compound, observe as the seeds sprout and grow to a big tree, its branches and compare it to the growth of God’s kingdom, Church, God. How does the parable of the mustard seed relate to the kingdom of God?

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Parable of the mustard seed.
2. Explain Parable of the mustard seed to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: read Luke 13:18-19 and narrate the parable,
4. Show that you can: retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Parable of the mustard seed. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: How does the parable of the mustard seed relate to the kingdom of God?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Luke 13:18-19 and narrate the parable,
2. Draw a big tree with birds resting on its branches and compare it to the growth of God’s kingdom,

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text,
2. describe how the kingdom of God grows from a small beginning,
3. explain how they contribute to the growth of the kingdom of God,
4. appreciate the growth of God’s kingdom by evangelising to others.
